newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast crudes fall, diffs flat late Wed.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast crudes fall, diffs flat late Wed.

text.p: U.S West Coast crudes fell with West Texas Intermediate (WTI) Wednesday, and discounts flattened as traders waited for the main Alaska crude seller to price cargoes, traders said.
Discounts for Alaska North Slope (ANS) crude remained at -$0.90 cents under WTI. Buyers looked into foreign barrels as they recalled a year-ago ANS price of $0.60 below WTI.
Outright prices stood $19.50/19.70, falling 25 cents in line with spot WTI.
Line 63 stood unchanged at postings plus $0.95 - $1.05, with a significant deal done early at $1.00 over postings.
Kern River heavy crude prices remained flat, with no new deals done.
